title: Listening Drill — Art fair ticket desk — Trial review
description: Conversation about a trial. One synthetic recording, six questions. Recommended time: 7 minutes.

sections.title: Art fair ticket desk — Trial review
sections.transcript:
HOST: You ran two introductory sessions on art fair ticket desk last week. What happened in the first one?

GUEST: On the first run, several people reported a problem with slow entry. At first we wondered whether it was a problem with the instructions. A closer inspection revealed the fault: broken scanner.

HOST: What changed when you ran the session again?

GUEST: On each trial, we now keep a record of ticket code so changes can be compared. For the second trial we let everyone borrow entry receipt instead of bringing their own. That helped us keep the equipment as consistent as possible.

HOST: What should people who attended do now?

GUEST: Send any suggestions directly to the ticket supervisor before the next group arrives. The next group comes on Monday, so we have time to compare notes beforehand.
